title: The Lord Is My Rock and My Fortress

questions.question: I love you, O Lord, my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 18:1 (ESV): "I love you, O Lord, my strength."

questions.question: The Lord is my rock and my fortress and my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 18:2 (ESV): "The Lord is my rock and my fortress and my deliverer..."

questions.question: I call upon the Lord, who is worthy to be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 18:3 (ESV): "I call upon the Lord, who is worthy to be praised,"

questions.question: In my distress I called upon the Lord; to my God I cried for what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 18:6 (ESV): "In my distress I called upon the Lord; to my God I cried for help."

questions.question: He rescued me from my strong enemy and from those who did what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 18:17 (ESV): "He rescued me from my strong enemy and from those who hated me..."

questions.question: From his temple he heard my voice, and my cry to him reached his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 18:6 (ESV): "...From his temple he heard my voice, and my cry to him reached his ears."

questions.question: Then the earth reeled and rocked; the foundations also of the mountains trembled because he was what?
He bowed the heavens and came down; thick darkness was under his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 18:9 (ESV): "He bowed the heavens and came down; thick darkness was under his feet."

questions.question: He rode on a cherub and flew; he came swiftly on the wings of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 18:10 (ESV): "He rode on a cherub and flew; he came swiftly on the wings of the wind."

questions.question: The Lord dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he did what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 18:20 (ESV): "The Lord dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he rewarded me."

questions.question: For by you I can run against a troop, and by my God I can leap over a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 18:29 (ESV): "For by you I can run against a troop, and by my God I can leap over a wall."

questions.question: This God—his way is perfect; the word of the Lord is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 18:30 (ESV): "This God—his way is perfect; the word of the Lord proves true;"

questions.question: He trains my hands for war, so that my arms can bend a bow of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 18:34 (ESV): "He trains my hands for war, so that my arms can bend a bow of bronze."

questions.question: You gave a wide place for my steps under me, and my feet did not what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 18:36 (ESV): "You gave a wide place for my steps under me, and my feet did not slip."

questions.question: Great salvation he brings to his king, and shows steadfast love to his anointed, to whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 18:50 (ESV): "...to David and his offspring forever."

key_verse_text: The Lord is my rock and my fortress and my deliverer, my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
